Those burnt in the Fire for their sins who hold a mustard grain of faith are brought out through intercession, cast into the river of life, and sprout like seeds.
The hypocrites lose their light on the bridge over Hell, and by intercession people leave the Fire for Paradise; Jabir's account turned Yazid al-Faqir from the Khawarij view.
On the Day people seek intercession from Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus, who send them to Muhammad; he prostrates, intercedes in stages, and is first at Paradise's gate.
Every prophet has one prayer that is granted; the Prophet reserved his for interceding for his Ummah on the Day of Resurrection, for those who die associating nothing with Allah.
If a hundred Muslims, or forty who associate nothing with Allah, pray over a dead Muslim, their intercession is accepted; Ibn Abbas brought out his son once forty gathered.
